top.title: Fed’s Waller says central bank may need to ‘shock people’ with half-point rate hike
top.rewrite: Fed's Waller says central bank may need to 'shock people' with half-point rate hike
top.summary: Waller told CNBC a half-point rise is probably needed at the Fed's Dec. 8-9 meeting, and that the three quarter-point cuts from last year should be reversed, possibly with more to follow. 'I'm very, very concerned about inflation,' he said. Futures already fully price a quarter-point hike in December.

featured.title: Nvidia interim CEO says 'we’ve got this' as company looks to future without Jensen Huang
featured.rewrite: Nvidia interim CEO says 'we've got this' as company looks to future without Jensen Huang
featured.summary: Colette Kress, Nvidia's CFO since 2013, told the earnings call the company is well positioned after Jensen Huang's abrupt resignation last week. Quarterly revenue of $115.8 billion beat estimates. 'Our momentum is real. Our demand is accelerating,' she said.

featured.title: Kuwait says it repelled first Iranian attack in two months after US strikes island
featured.rewrite: Kuwait says it repelled first Iranian attack in two months after US strikes island
featured.summary: Kuwait said an Iranian drone attack targeting Ali Al Salem Airbase, which hosts US forces, was its first in over two months, with no damage reported. Bahrain also reported an attack after the US struck a missile site on Qeshm Island, and the UAE's state oil firm said a crew member was missing after a tanker was hit in the Gulf.

featured.title: Dems probe Lutnick son’s ties to Nvidia, stock trades in China ‘spy’ scandal investigation
featured.rewrite: Dems probe Lutnick son's ties to Nvidia, stock trades in China 'spy' scandal investigation
featured.summary: Reps. Raskin, Meeks and Kamlager-Dove asked Cantor Fitzgerald chairman Brandon Lutnick for years of Nvidia trading records and encrypted messages. They are probing whether Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick blocked curbs on Singapore's Megaspeed, suspected of smuggling restricted Nvidia chips to China.

featured.title: Mary Peltola finally declared winner of Alaska Senate race 2 weeks after midterms
featured.rewrite: Mary Peltola finally declared winner of Alaska Senate race 2 weeks after midterms
featured.summary: The AP called the race two weeks after Election Day: Peltola took 50.1% to Sullivan's 45.8% with more than 95% of ballots counted, giving Democrats a 56-44 Senate edge from January. She is Alaska's first Democratic senator since 2008, after a late row over a 'decoy' Dan Sullivan candidate, who drew 1.7%.

right.summary: Creative Artists Agency and K-pop and lifestyle giant Hybe have launched a partnership to expand Hybe's creative and commercial opportunities.
